package internal

// Fixture for HostnameLiteral (ADR-0042 two-plane addressing / deploy#635).
// External hostname/origin literals are illegal — they must derive from config.
// Intra-cluster connection addresses are the other plane and are legal here.

const (
	// illegal: external public origin hardcoded.
	issuer = "https://auth.example.invalid"
	// illegal: bare external host.
	appHost = "app.example.invalid"
	// illegal: stale rebrand domain.
	legacy = "app.zero-day.local"
)

// legal: intra-cluster connection address (the OTHER plane, not denied).
const daemonAddr = "daemon.example.svc:50051"

// legal: in-cluster Service FQDN.
const idpSvc = "idp.example.svc.cluster.local:8080"

// legal: a value read from config, not a hostname literal.
func origin(cfg struct{ ExternalOrigin string }) string {
	return cfg.ExternalOrigin
}
